design_decisions: Use a native AppKit overlay within the same NSWindow, not a second splash window.
Show the curtain before showWindow(nil) can expose EmbeddedEmulatorView.
Use the existing GameFrameTelemetry callback as eligibility authority.
Require a source frame newer than the eligibility baseline to complete host presentation before reveal.
Reveal on GameActivity in the normal path; active Riot login is the only pre-GameActivity interactive exception.
No elapsed-time fallback may reveal Android/SystemUI/PIN.
The curtain captures input and becomes first responder until reveal; then focus transfers to EmbeddedEmulatorView.
Once revealed, the state is latched for the session.
On pre-reveal runtime failure, keep artwork visible and show a native error above it.
Do not create a retry feature unless separately requested; preserve the current relaunch recovery behavior.
next_safe_action: Persist the implementation plan, ZenMC receipt, scope lock, and ZenGate receipt; do not mutate product source yet.

user_scope_change.from: Save approved splash asset only; no runtime behavior change.
user_scope_change.to: Implement a native startup curtain using that asset to hide Android/emulator/PIN startup noise until official TFT is visibly ready.

verified_facts: AppCoordinator shows MainWindowController before runtime startup.
MainWindowController currently uses EmbeddedEmulatorView as the entire content view.
EmbeddedEmulatorView receives Android frames immediately and therefore exposes boot/SystemUI/PIN noise today.
Informational runtime status is already suppressed; only errors are shown over the emulator view.
GameFrameTelemetry already distinguishes exact TFT GameActivity SurfaceView from active Riot MobileFREWebViewActivity.
Current code has a one-second GameFrameTelemetryWindow path that can be reused without new Android polling.
EmbeddedEmulatorView already knows the source-frame sequence it uploads/presents and can expose a bounded successful-present callback.
The splash image exists in the change but is not yet in the Xcode Resources build phase.
The host window enters native fullscreen about 0.6s after launch; the curtain must survive that resize without flashing underlying Android content.
zenmc_reason: Asynchronous event ordering between GameFrameTelemetry and Metal frame completion.
Failure/recovery combinations can otherwise expose Android or deadlock the curtain.
Input gating and one-way reveal are safety/UX invariants.
Manual Riot login is an interacting alternate path.
